day_gates.name: Day gates only
day_gates.text: Gates take lorries from 06:00 to 22:00 only, and cost less to staff. Lorries due at night wait for the morning.

day_shifts.name: Day shifts on the quay
day_shifts.text: The port works its ships day and night unless this is on: then quay cranes work 06:00 to 22:00 only, and cranes and tractors cost less to crew. Ships alongside at night wait for the morning.

appointments.name: Lorry appointments
appointments.text: Every gate that takes no bookings of its own books lorries by the hour, at a share of what its lanes can check. Queues at the gate shorten; boxes wait longer in the yard for a free hour. Early lorries wait in a truck park, or block a booth without one.

dual_cycling.name: Dual cycling
dual_cycling.text: Cranes load an export on the tractor's way in and send it off with an import, while exports are ready in the yard, instead of discharging first. Planning it costs a little each day.
